# Содержимое файла index.ts {#sec-api-index .appendix}

``` python
import express from 'express'
import {checkAuth} from './middleware/index.ts'
import bodyParser from 'body-parser';
import getConnectionInfo from './controllers/connections/graph.ts';
import { getSslTop } from './controllers/connections/ssl.ts';
import { getCountriesTop } from './controllers/connections/countries.ts';
import { getAlerts } from './controllers/connections/alert.ts';
import { downloadUserVpnConfig, getUserInfo } from './controllers/user/userControl.ts';
import { getBlockListCountries, getBlockListDomains } from './controllers/user/blockListControl.ts';
import { userFastEntry, userLogin, userRegistration, userSetShortCode } from './controllers/user/userEntryControl.ts';
import { userConfirmDepend, userDeleteDepends, userDenyDepend, userGetDepends } from './controllers/user/userDependControl.ts';
import { userGetNotifications, userSendNotification } from './controllers/user/userNotificationControl.ts';

export const app = express();
const PORT = 3000;

app.use(checkAuth)
app.use(bodyParser.json())

app.post('/traffic/connections/graph', getConnectionInfo);

app.post('/traffic/connections/ssl/top', getSslTop)

app.post('/traffic/connections/countries/top', getCountriesTop)

app.post('/traffic/connections/alert', getAlerts)

app.post('/traffic/users/info', getUserInfo)

app.post('/traffic/users/blockList/countries', getBlockListCountries)

app.post('/traffic/users/blockList/domains', getBlockListDomains)

app.post('/traffic/users/reg', userRegistration)

app.post('/traffic/users/login', userLogin)

app.post('/traffic/users/shortcode', userSetShortCode)

app.post('/traffic/users/download/config', downloadUserVpnConfig)

app.post('/traffic/users/deleteDepends', userDeleteDepends)

app.post('/traffic/users/getDepends', userGetDepends)

app.post('/traffic/users/confirmDepend', userConfirmDepend)

app.post('/traffic/users/denyDepend', userDenyDepend)

app.post('/traffic/users/sendNotiffication', userSendNotification)

app.post('/traffic/users/getNotiffications', userGetNotifications)

app.post('/traffic/users/fastEntry', userFastEntry)

app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0');
```
